draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 244th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 28th of 29 at CB. He went 237th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 passes defended in 2024, 13th of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 9 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: season snap share 6.2% (11th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 9 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 6.2% season snap share against a median of 27.6%, below the norm.
